text:
maria: heads-up — after the calibration tweak landed in staging this morning, our structured-output eval suite shows a 6.3% drop in exact-match on the invoice parser set and several hallucination flags. also seeing p95 latency spike by ~25ms on dedicated pools, SLOs started flapping. linking quick repro and traces below.

aj: saw that metric alert. is this the new mix-quant kernel switch (fp8-int4 pipeline) or the batcher heuristic change?

maria: both actually — PR #5123 toggled the per-layer kernel selection to prefer fp8_mixk_v2 when calibration score > 0.82, and the batcher now increases batch depth for short queries if gpus are under 40% util. suspect interaction.

kevin: can you paste profiler snippets? curious about kernel selection logs and KV cache behavior.

maria: pasting trimmed logs (from a failing run):
```
2026-03-18T09:12:01Z model=redwood-mixv2 request_id=abc123 layer=14 selected_kernel=fp8_mixk_v2 latency_ms=1.2
2026-03-18T09:12:01Z model=redwood-mixv2 request_id=abc123 layer=15 selected_kernel=int4_fallback_v1 latency_ms=4.8 reason="alignment_mismatch"
2026-03-18T09:12:01Z model=redwood-mixv2 request_id=abc123 kv_cache_hit=false kv_latency_ms=3.9
2026-03-18T09:12:01Z batcher=batch_id=42 batch_size=6 short_query=true gpu_util=28% chosen_depth=4
```

maria: note the mix of fp8 and int4 fallback on adjacent layers — that could explain quality drift. also KV cache miss rate jumped from 2%->13% for this workload.

aj: interesting. perf-bot, can you attach the flamegraphs for that span?

perf-bot: attached flamegraph -> https://perf.redwood.internal/fg/1859012345 (span=60s, model=redwood-mixv2). shows kernel memcpy + quant-reorder hotspots around layer 14-16.

kevin: that memcopy/quant-reorder overhead is probably from the calibration path; when we prefer fp8_mixk_v2 it does per-layer requantization buffers which bump mem traffic, and the batcher increasing short-query depth aggregates more small KV ops -> cache pressure.

sophie: repro steps I'll try: run eval set with exact seeds, toggling only kernel-selection (calib threshold) first, then only batcher heuristic, then both. can someone grant me a dedicated pool with the regression image?

maria: granted — pool redwood-dedicated-qa-7, image redwood/mixv2:calib-20260318.

aj: quick experiment results (local):
- kernel-selection-only (threshold=0.82): exact-match drop 4.8%, p95 +10ms, KV miss +6%
- batcher-only (depth heuristic): exact-match ~baseline, p95 +18ms, KV miss +9%
- both combined: exact-match drop 6.3%, p95 +25ms, halluc flags increased

aj: looks additive and synergistic — batcher increases KV pressure which triggers more fallbacks to int4 kernels on alignment, which then hurts accuracy.

kevin: hypothesis: when FP8 kernel gets selected but encounters alignment/padding it falls back to int4_fallback_v1 that uses a different quant scale scheme, causing distribution shift and hallucinations. we should check per-layer scaling stats emitted by calibration.

maria: here's a snippet of per-layer calib output for layer 14/15:
```
layer 14: scale_mean=0.0123 scale_std=0.0031 calib_score=0.87 chosen_format=fp8
layer 15: scale_mean=0.0458 scale_std=0.0012 calib_score=0.80 chosen_format=int4
```

maria: so layer 15 is borderline and flips depending on small numeric jitter. that flip combined with different KL correction in int4 path explains output delta.

sophie: action plan: 1) add deterministic gating to avoid mixed-format adjacent-layer execution for now (prefer uniform path across a small layer window), 2) revert batcher short-query depth heuristic until KV pressure is mitigated, 3) add per-request telemetry that records chosen_format sequence for the forward pass so we can correlate format transitions with eval deltas.

aj: +1 on telemetry and revert batcher by default for the next rollout. the deterministic gating might cost a few percent perf but likely stops hallucinations.

kevin: I'll sketch a short patch to ensure kernel selection favors format-stability in a 3-layer neighborhood: pseudo: `if any(neighbor.format != candidate.format) score -= stability_penalty`

maria: created internal ticket INF-7892 and linked failing eval traces and sample prompts. assigning to @sophie and @kevin.

deploy-bot: deploy queued for redwood-dedicated-qa-7 with image redwood/mixv2:calib-repro-20260318 (#deploy-4321).

sophie: I'll run the three-step bisect today, post results here. thanks for the quick triage. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks — please add any reproducer prompts you find to INF-7892 so QA can add a regression test.

kevin: will also add a unit test to assert no mixed-format adj-layer transitions unless explicitly allowed.

aj: marking this thread for the incident playbook and will follow up if we see more alerts after the revert.

maria: updating INF-7892 with current perf traces and a short checklist for rollback.

sophie: first bisect run complete: kernel-selection-only reproduces the exact-match drop reliably. moving to test gating patch next.

kevin: uploaded draft PR with stability_penalty = 0.15 and a flag `--prefer-uniform-format-window`. linking: https://git.redwood/infra/quant-kernel-select/pull/67

maria: perfect. meeting to review at 16:00 if needed.
